title: Bridging Structure and Semantics: Knowledge Graph Verification via Triple-to-Text Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.07780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic accuracy is an important dimension of knowledge graph quality. Graph-based scoring methods exploit relational structure, while textual representations allow classifiers to draw on knowledge encoded by pre-trained language models (PLMs). We present GenVer, a generative verifier that scores triples using both their serialized form and generated natural language representations (NLRs). A triple-text alignment procedure selects training pairs for a sequence-to-sequence generator; a BERT-based classifier then combines features from each triple and its generated NLR. On four FactFB variants, constructed from FB15k using perturbed negative triples, GenVer obtains the highest classification accuracy among the evaluated baselines, ranging from 88.56% to 91.52%. The experiments suggest that generated representations can help triple classification, while the case analysis also exposes semantic drift and high-confidence errors.

translated_title: 连接结构与语义：基于三元组到文本对齐的知识图谱验证
translated_abstract: 语义准确性是知识图谱质量的一个重要维度。基于图的评分方法利用关系结构，而文本表示则使分类器能够利用预训练语言模型（PLM）中编码的知识。我们提出了GenVer，一种生成式验证器，它利用三元组的序列化形式和生成的自然语言表示（NLR）来对三元组进行评分。通过三元组-文本对齐程序为序列到序列生成器选择训练样本对，然后由基于BERT的分类器将每个三元组及其生成的NLR的特征相结合。在从FB15k通过扰动负三元组构建的四个FactFB变体上，GenVer在评估的基线方法中取得了最高的分类准确率，范围从88.56%到91.52%。实验表明，生成的表示有助于三元组分类，同时案例分析也揭示了语义漂移和高置信度错误的存在。
tldr: 提出GenVer生成式验证器，通过对齐三元组及其生成的自然语言表示来融合图结构信息与预训练语言模型知识，在FactFB数据集上取得了最高达91.52%的三元组分类准确率。
